background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the group, A on average and the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026. The weak spot is CET1 of 10.3%, in the bottom quarter of US banks, while leverage of 5.8% and LCR of 119% are above the median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.9 points, with LCR broadly flat. The flagged news, the newest on 5 Oct 2026, is mixed: an analyst upgrade of the stock against a downgrade of its mortgage-servicer ratings, alongside the rating upgrade.
